fit.title: Applied AI engineer (agents)
fit.jd:
We are hiring an Applied AI Engineer.
- Build and ship LLM agents with tool calling (MCP)
- Design evals and tracing for production systems
- Strong Python; TypeScript a plus
- Work with business stakeholders end to end
- Experience with Kubernetes

fit.title: ML engineer (training)
fit.jd:
Requirements:
- Fine-tuning LLMs with LoRA and RLHF
- PyTorch at scale on GPU clusters
- Computer vision experience
- Publications at top venues

fit.title: AI solutions architect
fit.jd: As an AI Solutions Architect you will lead customer-facing discovery, design RAG and multi-agent architectures on Azure or Google Cloud, set governance and security guardrails, and enable teams through workshops.

fit.title: Data product manager
fit.jd:
- Own the data product roadmap
- Define metrics and dashboards with analytics teams
- Build reliable ETL pipelines and data quality checks
- SQL fluency

fit.title: Voice AI engineer
fit.jd:
- Build voice agents with ElevenLabs or Vapi
- Text-to-speech and speech recognition pipelines
- Java or Go backend services

fit.title: Forward deployed engineer
fit.jd: Forward deployed engineer. You will sit with clients, turn their workflows into automation with Claude and the Anthropic API, prototype in Next.js, and measure ROI.
